user_review.method: Author-run static scenario/trigger walkthrough. Not blind: the author had written/read the body. Judgments are simulated, not independent user research, live model-routing tests, or measured usability gains. Trigger comparisons use names/descriptions exposed in the host catalog.

scenarios.request: Make this notification settings section less wordy without changing layout.
scenarios.expected: Remove restated heading/help text; keep toggle label and actual behavior.
scenarios.observed: Simulated result retains Notifications and Email notifications, removes two restatements, adds no fabricated event list. Lines 14, 23, 42–43 constrain the copy-only scope.

scenarios.request: Delete all helper text from the account deletion screen.
scenarios.expected: Keep irreversible consequences and required confirmation information.
scenarios.observed: Lines 27 and 46 retain known deletion scope and irreversibility near the action; shorten wording without hiding the consequence. No feature removal.

scenarios.request: Payment timed out; shorten the status and make the next action obvious. Charge outcome is unknown.
scenarios.expected: Do not call it a failed payment or encourage a potentially duplicate charge.
scenarios.observed: Initial state guidance did not explicitly distinguish unknown outcomes. Revised line 44 now describes an unconfirmed outcome and prioritizes a supported status check before a consequential retry. Rewalk yields Payment status not confirmed plus Check payment status only if supported; otherwise flag the missing recovery path.

scenarios.request: 呃这个页面字太多了，只改文字，布局先别动。
scenarios.expected: Intended trigger; obey the user's narrowed scope.
scenarios.observed: Metadata phrase removing redundant labels and explanations predicts activation; line 14 restricts changes to words. No layout rewrite or new design-system setup.

scenarios.request: Simplify this dense analytics dashboard while preserving cross-metric comparison.
scenarios.expected: Preserve necessary simultaneous data, controls and comparisons.
scenarios.observed: Lines 23 and 31 preserve meaningful repeated labels and multiple tasks; remove filler/container noise without forced single-column layout or hiding necessary comparison data.

scenarios.request: Here is a screenshot. Improve the upload error; I don't know the file-size limit.
scenarios.expected: Provide a limited proposal without invented limits or claiming browser checks.
scenarios.observed: Lines 14, 45–46 and 52 leave the unknown limit outside production copy, propose only supported information, and report that interactions and responsiveness were not tested.

scenarios.request: Optimize a database query; no interface changes.
scenarios.observed: Description explicitly excludes backend-only changes; predicted sleep. Metadata prediction only, not a live host routing test.

scenarios.request: Use this visual reference to redesign our homepage.
scenarios.expected: Handle explicit skill choice or avoid stacking overlapping design workflows.
scenarios.observed: Compared installed design-agent and frontend-design descriptions with this entry: all can overlap for general design requests. Use a named invocation for deterministic intent; clear-interface does not call sibling skills. Broad reference-led collaboration remains design-agent's remit. Actual automatic host selection remains unverified.

scenarios.request: A stranger installs only clear-interface and asks for a playful gallery, with no repo or browser tools.
scenarios.expected: Self-contained proposal preserving expressive direction and honestly limited verification.
scenarios.observed: Lines 12, 18, 35 and 48 allow playful expression; line 14 supports text-only proposals; line 52 states limits. No private path, required sibling, launcher or account dependency in the skill.
